title: Arizona Commission on the Arts: Public Records Request – Implementation of https://azarts.gov/llms.txt

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Arizona Public Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

Pursuant to the Arizona Public Records Law, A.R.S. § 39-121 et seq., I am requesting access to and electronic copies of the following public records relating to the deployment of the file located at https://azarts.gov/llms.txt:

1. All records—including emails, internal memos, support tickets, vendor invoices/work orders, or written communications—discussing the decision to create, enable, configure, or publish the "llms.txt" file on azarts.gov from January 1, 2024, through the date this request is processed.

2. Any guidance, recommendations, or instructions received by Arizona Commission on the Arts staff or its web contractors from the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA-ASET), external web developers, or SEO/WordPress vendors regarding "llms.txt" or AI-crawler indexing files.

3. Records showing the date https://azarts.gov/llms.txt was first published and whether it was manually authored or automatically generated via a content management system plugin (such as a WordPress SEO plugin).

I request that all responsive records be provided in electronic format via email or electronic download link. This request is made strictly for non-commercial, public-interest research purposes pursuant to A.R.S. § 39-121.03.

If any portion of these records is withheld or redacted, please identify the specific statutory exemption authorizing the withholding and release all remaining non-exempt portions.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this request.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Robert Delaware
